# Narayana Industries

Narayana Industries is an ISO 9001:2015, EN 15085-2:2020+A1:2023, and ISO 3834-2:2021 certified precision manufacturing partner.
We specialize in heavy fabrication, advanced CNC machining, and high-reliability components for railway, automotive, power generation, and heavy industrial applications.
